title: CHOOGuard phase-qualified artifact, source-access, predicate, historical and evidence-projection contract
description: Fail-closed prepare -> candidate -> accept DAG with exact artifact identities, branch-scoped source-access guards, non-artifact predicates, bounded historical snapshots, captured-status provenance, deterministic compiler indexes, and read-only eligibility projection.

repoPath.description: NFC repo-relative exact path. Semantic validator rejects traversal, empty/dot segments, case aliases, backslashes, encoded paths, controls and globs.

path.description: NFC repo-relative exact path. Semantic validator rejects traversal, empty/dot segments, case aliases, backslashes, encoded paths, controls and globs.

wholeIssueAcceptance.description: Optional semantic annotation for an accept output only. Current missing-producer projection does not depend on this flag and never means the producer issue must close.

path.description: Exact path or terminal /** subtree. Case/traversal aliases rejected semantically.

edge.description: Exact relation-specific record. No irrelevant artifact, phase or purpose fields are accepted.

anyOf.description: NFC repo-relative exact path. Semantic validator rejects traversal, empty/dot segments, case aliases, backslashes, encoded paths, controls and globs.

path.description: NFC repo-relative exact path. Semantic validator rejects traversal, empty/dot segments, case aliases, backslashes, encoded paths, controls and globs.

authorityBlock.description: Explicit phase object preferred. String is supported compatibility shorthand for candidate and accept only, never prepare.

guardBindings.description: Exact expected-artifact identities for every guard on this selected alternative. Required semantically when the branch declares guards; empty or omitted only for an unguarded branch.

selectedInputs.description: Selections retained for this completed phase. Guarded selections must also occur in inputBindings with every guard binding.

phaseFrontier.description: Captured status metadata and evidence-supported planned phase are separate. This record never resets or rewrites captured status.

projectionState.description: Strict read-only status-ledger snapshot. Live projection requires fresh observedAt and complete active-issue frontiers. This object has no claim, transition, lease, assignment or write-authority fields.

phaseWriteScopes.description: Lossless phase-specific writer declarations. Runtime validation binds placeholders and enforces phase/mode/canonical invariants.

writerContext.description: Caller-supplied evidence only. It does not acquire a lease or establish authorization.

keyExpansion.const: workspaceId + canonicalized real paths, including generated closure

failure.const: reject overlap in same physical workspace; independent branches may prepare proposals, canonical integration still needs requiredLocks

keyExpansion.const: workspaceId + canonicalized real paths; generatedClosure must equal [] for #13

failure.const: Reject missing/extra path, alias overlap, different base, stale holder, duplicate fence, or any generated/scratch write. Preserve current work before wait/rebase/relocate/serialize.

rule.const: Same checkout conflicts even if Editor PID differs. Different checkouts/Editors/outputs can run concurrently when static integration locks also disjoint.
runId or source SHA alone never defines exclusivity; empty resource list means none used, not unknown; record actual shared ports/devices/processes.

realCheckoutPath.description: Caller-supplied canonical absolute real checkout path; semantic validation does not query the filesystem.

outputRoot.description: Caller-supplied canonical absolute real output root.

processStart.description: Caller-supplied process incarnation/start token; no OS observation is performed.

requirement.description: Evidence-backed planning only. Runtime checks require identity/code equality and registry/item/implements pair equality, one evidence record per pair, portable non-private paths, exact source pins and held-policy preservation.
